say:2:1141116002:1.text: Ha! What's that face for? Don't you worry. This will help you recover from fatigue.
say:2:1141116002:1.source_cn: 哈，看你那是什么表情，放心吧，这只是解乏的药剂罢了。
say:2:1141116002:1.male: Ha! What's that face for? Don't you worry. This will help you recover from fatigue.
say:2:1141116002:1.female: Ha! What's that face for? Don't you worry. This will help you recover from fatigue.

say:3:1141116003:1.text: Drink this, and you'll feel relaxed, both physically and mentally.
say:3:1141116003:1.source_cn: 喝下去后会让你放松一些，不光是身体，身心也会。
say:3:1141116003:1.male: Drink this, and you'll feel relaxed, both physically and mentally.
say:3:1141116003:1.female: Drink this, and you'll feel relaxed, both physically and mentally.

say:4:1141116004:1.text: Quit sniffing at it. It's not for sale. It is so good that I even couldn't bear to drink it!
say:4:1141116004:1.source_cn: 别闻了，这可是非卖品，连我自己都舍不得喝的好东西。
say:4:1141116004:1.male: Quit sniffing at it. It's not for sale. It is so good that I even couldn't bear to drink it!
say:4:1141116004:1.female: Quit sniffing at it. It's not for sale. It is so good that I even couldn't bear to drink it!
